name: Person Position

fields.label: Title (as stated)
fields.description: The wording of the source when it does not fit either label column ('مدرس أول', 'acting director').

fields.label: Institution
fields.description: Link when the institution is a registry record.

fields.label: Institution (as stated)
fields.description: Used when the body is not (yet) a registry record. Nothing is invented to fill the Link.

fields.label: Start (as stated)
fields.description: Exactly as the source gives it: 1950 · 1950-05 · 1950-05-12 · 1950-05-12T21:45 · 'c. 1850' · '1850s' · '1850?'. Authoritative value; the date field beside it is derived from it.

fields.label: Start (comparable)
fields.description: Machine-comparable value derived from the 'as stated' value; used for filters, sorting and reports. Never more precise than what is stated.

fields.label: Start precision
fields.options:
exact
minute
day
month
year
decade
approximate
uncertain
range
unknown
fields.description: How much of the date is actually known. 'approximate' keeps c. 1850; 'year' keeps 1850; 'decade' keeps '1850s'; 'minute' keeps a time of day.

fields.label: End (as stated)

fields.label: Current post
fields.description: The post the person holds now. More than one current post is allowed — people hold several.
